choice.stem: 다음 요약문의 빈칸 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것을 고르시오.

(A) timid — (B) questioning — (C) engineer
(A) timid — (B) obeying — (C) nurture
(A) self-driven — (B) obeying — (C) engineer
(A) self-driven — (B) questioning — (C) nurture
choice.ex: (A) self-driven (B) obeying (C) nurture 근거 ❷❸❹❻ 해설: (A) ❷❸ 스스로 탐구하고 담대하게 도전하며 진취성을 가짐 = 스스로 동기를 갖는(self-driven) / (B) ❹ accustomed to following others’ instructions = 지시를 따르는(obeying) / (C) ❻ 햇빛·비·토양을 제공해 자연스럽게 자라게 함 = 길러 주다(nurture). timid(소심한)는 adventurous와 나란히 쓰일 수 없고 ❸과 반대, questioning(의문을 제기하는)은 ❹와 반대, engineer(설계해 만들다)는 콤마 뒤 not to dictate it과 같은 뜻이 되어 모순. 요약문 해석: 부모가 정원사처럼 행동하면 아이들은 자신의 속도로 자유롭게 자라 (A) 스스로 동기를 갖고 모험심 있는 사람이 된다. 부모가 목수처럼 행동 하면 아이들은 타인의 지시를 (B) 따르는 데 익숙해져 자신의 길을 찾는 데 어려움을 겪는다. 그러므로 부모의 일은 성장을 (C) 길러 주는 것이지, 성장을 지시하는 것이 아니다.
choice.psg: ❶ Life is full of possibilities. ❷ If we, like gardeners, provide a suitable environment and let children grow at their own pace, they will spontaneously explore the world, developing curiosity, creativity, and independence. ❸ Such children love life, dare to challenge, and possess initiative. ❹ But if we, like carpenters, always try to “shape” children into our ideal image, they will gradually lose autonomy, becoming accustomed to following others’ instructions. ❺ Such children quickly lose their sense of direction as they grow, because they are used to being arranged for, rather than actively choosing their path. ❻ As parents, our role should be that of gardeners, providing sunlight, rain, and fertile soil, allowing children to grow naturally at their own pace. ❼ It should not be that of carpenters, trying to carve out a “perfect” piece according to our will. ❽ The core of education starts with understanding life and helping children find their own “map” to find their direction in a complex world.
choice.body: When parents act like gardeners, children are free to grow at their own pace and become (A)________ and adventurous. When parents act like carpenters, children grow used to (B)________ others’ instructions and struggle to find their way. Thus, the parent’s job is to (C)________ growth, not to dictate it.

choice.psg: ❶ Life is full of possibilities. ❷ If we, like gardeners, provide a suitable environment and let children grow at their own pace, they will spontaneously explore the world, developing curiosity, creativity, and independence. ❸ Such children love life, dare to challenge, and possess initiative. ❹ But if we, like carpenters, always try to “shape” children into our ideal image, they will gradually lose autonomy, becoming accustomed to following others’ instructions. ❺ Such children quickly lose their sense of direction as they grow, because they are used to being arranged for, rather than actively choosing their path. ❻ As parents, our role should be that of gardeners, providing sunlight, rain, and fertile soil, allowing children to grow naturally at their own pace. ❼ It should not be that of carpenters, trying to carve out a “perfect” piece according to our will. ❽ The core of education starts with understanding life and helping children find their own “map” to find their direction in a complex world.
choice.body: Children who are constantly shaped by adults’ plans grow accustomed to having choices made for them, so they easily (A)________ as they grow. True education, therefore, begins with helping children (B)________ their own paths in a complex world, just as a gardener (C)________ a plant’s natural growth.

choice.stem: 위 글의 내용으로부터 추론할 수 없는 것을 고르시오.
opt: Providing a suitable environment is presented as a key duty of parents.
Constant attempts to mold children can weaken their ability to make their own choices.
Children raised by gardener-like parents tend to achieve higher grades at school than others.
Children raised with freedom are more likely to take on challenges with confidence.
The writer uses the images of gardeners and carpenters to contrast two parenting styles.
choice.ex: 본문은 정원사형 양육의 결과로 호기심·창의성·독립심(❷), 삶에 대한 사랑·도전·진취성(❸)만 말할 뿐 학교 성적은 전혀 언급하지 않는 다(원문 밖 결과). 나머지는 ❷❸ / ❹❺ / ❷❹❻❼ / ❻에서 추론 가능. ① 근거 ❻ — 적절한 환경을 제공하는 것이 부모의 핵심 의무로 제시된다. ② 근거 ❹❺ — 아이들을 틀에 맞추려는 끊임없는 시도는 스스로 선택하는 능력을 약화시킬 수 있다. ③ 근거 없음(정답) — 정원사 같은 부모가 키운 아이들은 다른 아이들보다 학교 성적이 더 높은 경향이 있다. ④ 근거 ❷❸ — 자유롭게 자란 아이들은 자신감을 갖고 도전에 맞설 가능성이 더 크다. ⑤ 근거 ❷❹❻❼ — 필자는 정원사와 목수의 이미지를 사용해 두 가지 양육 방식을 대조한다.
choice.psg: ❶ Life is full of possibilities. ❷ If we, like gardeners, provide a suitable environment and let children grow at their own pace, they will spontaneously explore the world, developing curiosity, creativity, and independence. ❸ Such children love life, dare to challenge, and possess initiative. ❹ But if we, like carpenters, always try to “shape” children into our ideal image, they will gradually lose autonomy, becoming accustomed to following others’ instructions. ❺ Such children quickly lose their sense of direction as they grow, because they are used to being arranged for, rather than actively choosing their path. ❻ As parents, our role should be that of gardeners, providing sunlight, rain, and fertile soil, allowing children to grow naturally at their own pace. ❼ It should not be that of carpenters, trying to carve out a “perfect” piece according to our will. ❽ The core of education starts with understanding life and helping children find their own “map” to find their direction in a complex world.

choice.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 부분이 의미하는 바로 가장 적절한 것을 고르시오.
opt: praising children only when they produce perfect results
giving children complete freedom to do whatever they want
teaching children practical skills such as woodworking and crafts
forcing children to develop into the ideal form that parents have in mind
protecting children from every danger in a complex world
choice.ex: 밑줄 해석: 우리의 의지대로 ‘완벽한’ 작품을 조각해 내려고 노력하는 것 → 부모의 이상에 맞춰 아이를 만들어 내려는 것 해설: ‘목수가 자기 뜻대로 완벽한 작품을 깎아 내다’는 ❹의 try to “shape” children into our ideal image를 다시 말한 비유 → 부모의 이상에 맞춰 아이 를 만들려는 것. 목공 기술을 가르친다는 것은 carve를 문자 그대로 읽은 함정, 완전한 자유를 준다는 것은 정반대(정원사도 환경은 제공함), 완벽한 결과 에만 칭찬한다는 것은 “perfect”라는 단어만 이용한 왜곡, 모든 위험에서 보호한다는 것은 무관. ① 아이들이 완벽한 결과를 낼 때에만 칭찬하는 것 ② 아이들에게 원하는 것은 무엇이든 할 수 있는 완전한 자유를 주는 것 ③ 아이들에게 목공이나 공예 같은 실용적인 기술을 가르치는 것 ④ 부모가 마음속에 그리는 이상적인 모습으로 자라도록 아이들을 강요하는 것 ⑤ 복잡한 세상의 모든 위험으로부터 아이들을 보호하는 것
choice.body: As parents, our role should be that of gardeners, providing sunlight, rain, and fertile soil, allowing children to grow naturally at their own pace. It should not be that of carpenters, trying to carve out a “perfect” piece according to our will. The core of education starts with understanding life and helping children find their own “map” to find their direction in a complex world.
choice.ul: trying to carve out a “perfect” piece according to our will.

choice.stem: 다음 요약문의 빈칸 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것을 고르시오.
opt: (A) grow — (B) compensates — (C) equal to
(A) shrink — (B) punishes — (C) equal to
(A) shrink — (B) compensates — (C) preferred to
(A) grow — (B) punishes — (C) preferred to
(A) grow — (B) compensates — (C) preferred to
choice.ex: (A) grow (B) compensates (C) preferred to 근거 ❸❹❺❻❼ 해설: (A) ❹ The longer …, the higher the chance … and the longer you wil have to wait = 기다림·위험이 커짐 / (B) ❺ income to the lender + ❻ factors in the value of time = 시간에 대해 보상 / (C) ❼ 손안의 새 한 마리 = 지금의 돈이 더 낫다. shrink(줄어들다)는 ❹와 반대, punishes(벌하 다)는 ❺(빌려준 사람의 수입)와 반대, equal to(같은)는 ❼ 속담과 반대. 요약문 해석: 돈을 빌려준다는 것은 그것을 지금 쓸 기회를 포기하고 그것이 결코 돌아오지 않을 수도 있음을 받아들이는 것이다. 대출이 길어질수록 기다 림과 손실의 위험이 모두 (A) 커지기 때문에, 돈은 관련된 시간에 대해 빌려준 사람에게 (B) 보상해 주는 가격을 지녀야 한다. 이런 의미에서 오늘의 돈은 내일의 돈보다 (C) 선호된다.
choice.psg: ❶ To see how borrowing and lending changes a person’s worldview, consider what the rate of interest does to people’s perception of time. ❷ Imagine you are lending to somebody at an interest rate of 10 percent per year for five years. ❸ This rate tells us that the money lent has a cost that reflects the risk of you not being repaid and the opportunity cost of not spending that money yourself. ❹ The longer the term of the loan, the higher the chance you won’t be paid back because it is further into the future — which by definition is unknowable — and the longer you will have to wait before spending the money yourself. ❺ In order to make this worthwhile for the lender, money has to have a price — a cost to the borrower and income to the lender. ❻ This price factors in the value of time. ❼ To put it another way, a bird in the hand is worth two in the bush.
choice.body: Lending money means giving up the chance to use it now and accepting that it may never come back. Since both the waiting and the danger of loss (A)________ as a loan lasts longer, money must carry a price that (B)________ the lender for the time involved. In this sense, money today is (C)________ money tomorrow.

choice.stem: 다음 요약문의 빈칸 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것을 고르시오.

choice.ex: (A) uncertain (B) postpone (C) hoping for 근거 ❹❼ 해설: (A) ❹ which by definition is unknowable = 상환이 불확실 / (B) ❹ the longer you wil have to wait before spending = 소비를 미룸 / (C) ❼ 덤불 속 두 마리 = 아직 손에 없는, 바라기만 하는 것. predictable(예측 가능한)은 ‘알 수 없는’과 반대, start(시작하다)는 ‘기다려야 한다’와 반대, holding 은 앞의 already hold와 같은 말이 되어 비교가 성립하지 않음. 요약문 해석: 대출이 오래 지속될수록, 앞날은 알 수 없기 때문에 상환은 더 (A) 불확실해지고, 빌려준 사람은 그 돈을 쓰는 것을 더 오래 (B) 미뤄야 한다. 이것이, 속담에서 말하듯, 이미 가지고 있는 것이 단지 (C) 바라고 있는 것보다 더 가치 있는 이유이다.
choice.psg: ❶ To see how borrowing and lending changes a person’s worldview, consider what the rate of interest does to people’s perception of time. ❷ Imagine you are lending to somebody at an interest rate of 10 percent per year for five years. ❸ This rate tells us that the money lent has a cost that reflects the risk of you not being repaid and the opportunity cost of not spending that money yourself. ❹ The longer the term of the loan, the higher the chance you won’t be paid back because it is further into the future — which by definition is unknowable — and the longer you will have to wait before spending the money yourself. ❺ In order to make this worthwhile for the lender, money has to have a price — a cost to the borrower and income to the lender. ❻ This price factors in the value of time. ❼ To put it another way, a bird in the hand is worth two in the bush.
choice.body: The longer a loan lasts, the more (A)________ its repayment becomes, because what lies ahead is impossible to know, and the longer the lender must (B)________ spending the money. This is why, as the saying goes, what you already hold is worth more than what you are merely (C)________.

choice.stem: 위 글의 내용으로부터 추론할 수 없는 것을 고르시오.
opt: Higher interest rates encourage people to save more of their income instead of borrowing.
Interest serves as a cost to the person who borrows and as earnings for the person who lends.
A loan that lasts five years is generally less safe for the lender than one that lasts a single year.
When you lend money, you give up the chance to spend it on something else in the meantime.
The writer uses a familiar saying to restate the idea that time affects the value of money.
choice.ex: 본문은 이자가 왜 존재하는지(위험·기회비용·시간의 가치)를 빌려주는 사람 입장에서 설명할 뿐, 이자율이 높을 때 사람들의 저축·대출 행동이 어떻게 바뀌는지는 전혀 말하지 않는다(경제 상식을 이용한 원문 밖 인과). 나머지는 ❹ / ❸ / ❺ / ❻❼에서 추론 가능. ① 근거 없음(정답) — 더 높은 이자율은 사람들이 빌리는 대신 소득을 더 많이 저축하도록 장려한다. ② 근거 ❺ — 이자는 빌리는 사람에게는 비용으로, 빌려주는 사람에게는 소득으로 작용한다. ③ 근거 ❹ — 5년 동안 지속되는 대출은 일반적으로 1년짜리 대출보다 빌려주는 사람에게 덜 안전하다. ④ 근거 ❸ — 돈을 빌려줄 때, 여러분은 그동안 그것을 다른 무언가에 쓸 기회를 포기한다. ⑤ 근거 ❻❼ — 필자는 시간이 돈의 가치에 영향을 준다는 생각을 다시 말하기 위해 친숙한 속담을 사용한다.
choice.psg: ❶ To see how borrowing and lending changes a person’s worldview, consider what the rate of interest does to people’s perception of time. ❷ Imagine you are lending to somebody at an interest rate of 10 percent per year for five years. ❸ This rate tells us that the money lent has a cost that reflects the risk of you not being repaid and the opportunity cost of not spending that money yourself. ❹ The longer the term of the loan, the higher the chance you won’t be paid back because it is further into the future — which by definition is unknowable — and the longer you will have to wait before spending the money yourself. ❺ In order to make this worthwhile for the lender, money has to have a price — a cost to the borrower and income to the lender. ❻ This price factors in the value of time. ❼ To put it another way, a bird in the hand is worth two in the bush.

choice.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 부분이 의미하는 바로 가장 적절한 것을 고르시오.
opt: shows that time is far more precious than money in daily life
stays the same no matter how long the loan lasts
depends mainly on how much the lender trusts the borrower’s character
charges the borrower for the period during which the lender cannot use the money

choice.ex: 밑줄 해석: 이 가격은 시간의 가치를 감안한다 → 빌려준 사람이 돈을 쓰지 못하고 기다리는 기간(과 그동안의 불확실성)에 대한 대가가 이자에 포함된다 해설: ‘시간의 가치를 감안한다’ = 빌려준 기간 동안 그 돈을 쓰지 못하고(❸ 기회비용) 기다리는 것(❹)에 값을 매겨 빌린 사람에게 물린다는 뜻이고, ❼ 속 담(지금 가진 것이 나중의 두 배만큼 가치)이 이를 다시 말한다. ‘얼마나 빨리 쓰는지 측정’은 주체를 바꾼 왜곡, ‘기간과 상관없이 같다’는 ❹와 정반대, ‘인 격에 대한 신뢰’는 본문에 없는 내용, ‘일상에서 시간이 돈보다 소중’은 value of time을 문자 그대로·일반론으로 확대한 함정. ① 일상생활에서 시간이 돈보다 훨씬 더 소중하다는 것을 보여 준다 ② 대출이 얼마나 오래 지속되든 상관없이 똑같이 유지된다 ③ 주로 빌려준 사람이 빌린 사람의 인격을 얼마나 신뢰하는지에 달려 있다 ④ 빌려준 사람이 그 돈을 쓸 수 없는 기간에 대해 빌린 사람에게 대가를 물린다 ⑤ 빌린 사람이 빌린 돈을 얼마나 빨리 쓸 수 있는지를 측정한다
choice.body: In order to make this worthwhile for the lender, money has to have a price — a cost to the borrower and income to the lender. This price factors in the value of time. To put it another way, a bird in the hand is worth two in the bush.
choice.ul: factors in the value of time.

choice.stem: 다음 요약문의 빈칸 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것을 고르시오.
opt: (A) ignore — (B) resist — (C) in conflict
(A) shape — (B) resist — (C) consistent
(A) shape — (B) foster — (C) consistent
(A) shape — (B) foster — (C) in conflict
(A) ignore — (B) foster — (C) consistent
choice.ex: (A) shape (B) foster (C) consistent 근거 ❹❻ 해설: (A) ❹ a platform that can influence their audience’s attitudes and behaviors = 생각·행동을 형성 / (B) ❹ use that platform for positive change = 긍정적 변화를 촉진 / (C) ❻ their content aligns with their … principles = 가치와 일치. ignore(무시하다)는 ‘플랫폼이 할 수 있는 일’로 성립 하지 않고 ❹와 반대, resist(저항하다)는 positive change와 반대, in conflict(충돌하는)는 ❻과 반대. 요약문 해석: 사회적·환경적 문제에 대한 대중의 관심이 커지면서, 콘텐츠 제작자들은 자신의 제품 이상의 것을 고려하도록 기대받는다. 그들의 플랫폼은 청중이 생각하고 행동하는 방식을 (A) 형성할 수 있기 때문에, 그들은 그것을 긍정적인 변화를 (B) 촉진하는 데 사용하고 자신의 콘텐츠를 자신이 지닌 가 치와 (C) 일치하게 유지해야 한다.
choice.psg: ❶ Social and environmental responsibility has become an increasingly important ethical consideration for content creators. ❷ As global awareness of social, environmental, and sustainability issues grows, many content creators are being called upon to consider the broader impact of their work. ❸ This includes addressing topics such as climate change, social justice, and ethical consumerism in their content. ❹ Content creators have a platform that can influence their audience’s attitudes and behaviors, and they have a responsibility to use that platform for positive change. ❺ For example, promoting environmentally sustainable products or supporting causes related to equality and justice can help raise awareness and drive meaningful social impact. ❻ Ethical content creators not only focus on promoting their products or services but also consider the values and causes they support, ensuring that their content aligns with their social and environmental principles.
choice.body: As public concern for social and environmental issues rises, content creators are expected to consider more than their own products. Because their platforms can (A)________ how audiences think and act, they should use them to (B)________ positive change and keep their content (C)________ with the values they hold.

choice.stem: 다음 요약문의 빈칸 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것을 고르시오.
opt: (A) heighten — (B) beyond — (C) reflects
(A) heighten — (B) beyond — (C) contradicts
(A) heighten — (B) no further than — (C) reflects
(A) lower — (B) beyond — (C) reflects
(A) lower — (B) no further than — (C) contradicts
choice.ex: (A) heighten (B) beyond (C) reflects 근거 ❺❻ 해설: (A) ❺ help raise awareness = 인식을 높이다 / (B) ❻ not only focus on promoting their products … but also consider = 홍보 너머를 봄 / (C) ❻ aligns with their … principles = 원칙을 반영. lower(낮추다)는 ❺와 반대, no further than(~ 이상은 보지 않다)은 ❻ not only … but also와 반 대, contradicts(모순되다)는 ❻과 반대. 요약문 해석: 친환경 제품을 홍보하거나 평등 같은 대의를 지지하는 것은 대중의 인식을 (A) 높이고 의미 있는 사회적 영향으로 이어질 수 있다. 그러므로 진정으로 윤리적인 제작자들은 자신이 파는 것을 단지 홍보하는 것 (B) 너머를 보며, 자신의 콘텐츠가 자신이 지닌 원칙을 (C) 반영하도록 한다.
choice.psg: ❶ Social and environmental responsibility has become an increasingly important ethical consideration for content creators. ❷ As global awareness of social, environmental, and sustainability issues grows, many content creators are being called upon to consider the broader impact of their work. ❸ This includes addressing topics such as climate change, social justice, and ethical consumerism in their content. ❹ Content creators have a platform that can influence their audience’s attitudes and behaviors, and they have a responsibility to use that platform for positive change. ❺ For example, promoting environmentally sustainable products or supporting causes related to equality and justice can help raise awareness and drive meaningful social impact. ❻ Ethical content creators not only focus on promoting their products or services but also consider the values and causes they support, ensuring that their content aligns with their social and environmental principles.
choice.body: Promoting eco-friendly products or backing causes such as equality can (A)________ public awareness and lead to meaningful social impact. Truly ethical creators, then, look (B)________ merely promoting what they sell and make sure their content (C)________ the principles they hold.

choice.stem: 위 글의 내용으로부터 추론할 수 없는 것을 고르시오.
opt: Ethical creators pay attention to whether their content matches their own principles.
Audiences tend to lose trust in creators who discuss climate change or social justice.
Promoting sustainable products is one way creators can contribute to social good.
Content creators today are expected to think about how their work affects society as a whole.
A creator’s platform can be a powerful tool for changing what audiences believe and do.
choice.ex: 본문은 기후 변화·사회 정의 같은 주제를 다루는 것이 제작자의 책임에 포함된다고(❸) 할 뿐, 그런 주제를 다룰 때 청중이 신뢰를 잃는 다는 반응은 전혀 언급하지 않는다(원문 밖 결과). 나머지는 ❷ / ❹ / ❺ / ❻에서 추론 가능. ① 근거 ❻ — 윤리적인 제작자들은 자신의 콘텐츠가 자신의 원칙과 맞는지에 주의를 기울인다. ② 근거 없음(정답) — 청중은 기후 변화나 사회 정의를 다루는 제작자들에 대한 신뢰를 잃는 경향이 있다. ③ 근거 ❺ — 지속가능한 제품을 홍보하는 것은 제작자가 사회적 선에 기여할 수 있는 한 가지 방법이다. ④ 근거 ❷ — 오늘날 콘텐츠 제작자들은 자신의 작업이 사회 전체에 어떤 영향을 미치는지 생각하도록 기대받는다. ⑤ 근거 ❹ — 제작자의 플랫폼은 청중이 믿고 행하는 것을 바꾸는 강력한 도구가 될 수 있다.
choice.psg: ❶ Social and environmental responsibility has become an increasingly important ethical consideration for content creators. ❷ As global awareness of social, environmental, and sustainability issues grows, many content creators are being called upon to consider the broader impact of their work. ❸ This includes addressing topics such as climate change, social justice, and ethical consumerism in their content. ❹ Content creators have a platform that can influence their audience’s attitudes and behaviors, and they have a responsibility to use that platform for positive change. ❺ For example, promoting environmentally sustainable products or supporting causes related to equality and justice can help raise awareness and drive meaningful social impact. ❻ Ethical content creators not only focus on promoting their products or services but also consider the values and causes they support, ensuring that their content aligns with their social and environmental principles.

choice.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 부분이 의미하는 바로 가장 적절한 것을 고르시오.
opt: change the technology they use to share their content
avoid expressing any opinions on social issues
focus on increasing the number of their followers
build a larger stage for their live performances
use their influence over audiences to help make society better
choice.ex: 밑줄 해석: 그 플랫폼을 긍정적인 변화를 위해 사용하다 → 청중에게 미치는 영향력을 사회를 더 낫게 만드는 데 쓰다 해설: 여기서 platform은 앞 절의 ‘청중의 태도와 행동에 영향을 미칠 수 있는 플랫폼’, 즉 영향력이고, 뒤 ❺가 그 예(지속가능 제품 홍보·평등과 정의 지지 → 인식 제고·사회적 영향)를 든다. ‘더 큰 무대’와 ‘기술을 바꾸다’는 platform을 문자 그대로(무대·기술 플랫폼) 읽은 함정, ‘팔로워 수 늘리기’는 positive change를 개인적 성공으로 왜곡, ‘사회 문제에 의견을 내지 않음’은 ❸과 정반대. ① 콘텐츠를 공유하는 데 쓰는 기술을 바꾸다 ② 사회적 문제에 대해 어떤 의견도 표현하지 않다 ③ 자신의 팔로워 수를 늘리는 데 집중하다 ④ 라이브 공연을 위해 더 큰 무대를 짓다 ⑤ 청중에 대한 자신의 영향력을 사회를 더 낫게 만드는 데 사용하다
choice.body: This includes addressing topics such as climate change, social justice, and ethical consumerism in their content. Content creators have a platform that can influence their audience’s attitudes and behaviors, and they have a responsibility to use that platform for positive change. For example, promoting environmentally sustainable products or supporting causes related to equality and justice can help raise awareness and drive meaningful social impact.
choice.ul: use that platform for positive change.

choice.stem: 다음 요약문의 빈칸 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것을 고르시오.
opt: (A) imitate — (B) independent — (C) deal
(A) manage — (B) independent — (C) deal
(A) manage — (B) obedient — (C) deal
(A) imitate — (B) obedient — (C) compete
(A) manage — (B) independent — (C) compete
choice.ex: (A) manage (B) independent (C) deal 근거 ❸❹❺❻ 해설: (A) ❹ capable of controlling complex movements … locally = 움직임을 스스로 처리 / (B) ❺ do not require detailed instructions from the brain = 독립적인 / (C) ❻ interact with the environment directly = 주변 환경을 직접 상대. imitate(흉내 내다)는 근거 없음, obedient(순종적인)는 ❺ 와 반대, compete(경쟁하다)는 ‘상호 작용’을 ‘다툼’으로 바꾼 오답. 요약문 해석: 문어는 뉴런의 절반 이상을 다리에 두고 있어서, 각 다리가 많은 움직임을 스스로 (A) 처리할 수 있다. 그러므로 그 다리들은 뇌의 수동적인 도구라기보다 주변 환경을 직접 (C) 상대하는 (B) 독립적인 동반자처럼 행동한다.
choice.psg: ❶ Research on cephalopod neurobiology suggests that an octopus possesses roughly five hundred million neurons. ❷ What makes this system unusual is where many of those neurons are located. ❸ More than half are distributed throughout the arms rather than concentrated entirely in the central brain. ❹ Each arm contains networks of nerve cells capable of controlling complex movements and responding to sensory input locally. ❺ This means that many actions do not require detailed instructions from the brain itself. ❻ Instead, the arms function as highly capable extensions of the nervous system that interact with the environment directly. ❼ The suckers lining each arm play an important role in this process. ❽ These structures provide strong grip but also detect chemical signals on surfaces they contact. ❾ Marine biologists studying octopus behavior have shown that this allows the animal to gather chemical information through touch. ❿ In practical terms, an octopus can effectively taste what it touches.
choice.body: An octopus keeps more than half of its neurons in its arms, which allows each arm to (A)________ many movements on its own. The arms therefore act less like passive tools of the brain and more like (B)________ partners that (C)________ with their surroundings directly.

choice.stem: 다음 요약문의 빈칸 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것을 고르시오.
opt: (A) repel — (B) tasting — (C) information-gathering
(A) recognize — (B) hearing — (C) information-gathering
(A) recognize — (B) tasting — (C) information-gathering
(A) recognize — (B) tasting — (C) decorative
(A) repel — (B) hearing — (C) decorative
choice.ex: (A) recognize (B) tasting (C) information-gathering 근거 ❽❾❿ 해설: (A) ❽ detect chemical signals on surfaces they contact = 접촉한 물질을 알아봄 / (B) ❿ can effectively taste what it touches = 맛보기 / (C) ❾ gather chemical information through touch = 정보 수집 기관. repel(물리치다)은 근거 없음, hearing(듣기)은 ❿의 taste와 다름, decorative(장식용의)는 ❼ important role과 반대. 요약문 해석: 문어 다리를 따라 있는 빨판은 붙잡는 것 이상의 일을 한다. 그것들은 접촉하는 물질을 (A) 알아보기도 한다. 이런 의미에서 문어에게 만지는 것은 우리에게 (B) 맛보는 것과 매우 비슷하게 작용하여, 그 다리를 움직임의 도구일 뿐 아니라 (C) 정보를 수집하는 기관으로 만든다.
choice.psg: ❶ Research on cephalopod neurobiology suggests that an octopus possesses roughly five hundred million neurons. ❷ What makes this system unusual is where many of those neurons are located. ❸ More than half are distributed throughout the arms rather than concentrated entirely in the central brain. ❹ Each arm contains networks of nerve cells capable of controlling complex movements and responding to sensory input locally. ❺ This means that many actions do not require detailed instructions from the brain itself. ❻ Instead, the arms function as highly capable extensions of the nervous system that interact with the environment directly. ❼ The suckers lining each arm play an important role in this process. ❽ These structures provide strong grip but also detect chemical signals on surfaces they contact. ❾ Marine biologists studying octopus behavior have shown that this allows the animal to gather chemical information through touch. ❿ In practical terms, an octopus can effectively taste what it touches.
choice.body: The suckers along an octopus’s arms do more than grip; they also (A)________ the substances they come into contact with. In this sense, touching works for the octopus much like (B)________ does for us, turning its arms into (C)________ organs as well as tools for movement.

choice.stem: 위 글의 내용으로부터 추론할 수 없는 것을 고르시오.
opt: The placement of neurons in its arms is what sets the octopus nervous system apart.
An octopus does not depend entirely on its brain to carry out complex arm movements.
The suckers serve more than one purpose for the octopus.
Contact with an object can give an octopus clues about what that object is made of.
An octopus’s arms can grow back quickly because they contain so many nerve cells.
choice.ex: 본문은 다리의 신경 세포가 움직임 통제와 감각 반응을 맡는다고만 할 뿐(❹~❻), 다리의 재생이나 그 속도는 전혀 언급하지 않는다(배 경지식을 이용한 원문 밖 인과). 나머지는 ❹❺ / ❷❸ / ❼❽ / ❽~❿에서 추론 가능. ① 근거 ❷❸ — 다리에 뉴런이 배치되어 있다는 점이 문어 신경계를 특별하게 만드는 것이다. ② 근거 ❹❺ — 문어는 복잡한 다리 움직임을 수행하는 데 전적으로 뇌에만 의존하지는 않는다. ③ 근거 ❼❽ — 빨판은 문어에게 한 가지 이상의 목적에 쓰인다. ④ 근거 ❽❾❿ — 물체와의 접촉은 문어에게 그 물체가 무엇으로 만들어졌는지에 대한 단서를 줄 수 있다. ⑤ 근거 없음(정답) — 문어의 다리는 매우 많은 신경 세포를 가지고 있기 때문에 빠르게 다시 자랄 수 있다.
choice.psg: ❶ Research on cephalopod neurobiology suggests that an octopus possesses roughly five hundred million neurons. ❷ What makes this system unusual is where many of those neurons are located. ❸ More than half are distributed throughout the arms rather than concentrated entirely in the central brain. ❹ Each arm contains networks of nerve cells capable of controlling complex movements and responding to sensory input locally. ❺ This means that many actions do not require detailed instructions from the brain itself. ❻ Instead, the arms function as highly capable extensions of the nervous system that interact with the environment directly. ❼ The suckers lining each arm play an important role in this process. ❽ These structures provide strong grip but also detect chemical signals on surfaces they contact. ❾ Marine biologists studying octopus behavior have shown that this allows the animal to gather chemical information through touch. ❿ In practical terms, an octopus can effectively taste what it touches.

choice.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 부분이 의미하는 바로 가장 적절한 것을 고르시오.
opt: protect the central brain from damage in dangerous places
pass every message back to the brain for approval
help the octopus swim faster than any other sea creature
operate as skilled branches of the nervous system that can perceive and react on their own
grow longer and stronger as the central brain develops
choice.ex: 밑줄 해석: 신경계의 대단히 유능한 연장선으로서 작동한다 → 뇌의 지시 없이도 스스로 감지하고 반응하는 신경계의 일부처럼 기능한 다 해설: 바로 앞 ❺(뇌의 상세한 지시가 필요 없다)와 Instead로 이어지므로, ‘신경계의 유능한 연장선’ = 뇌의 일부처럼 스스로 감지·반응하는 다리. ‘더 길고 강해진다’는 extension을 문자 그대로(길이 연장) 읽은 함정, ‘모든 메시지를 뇌로 보내 승인받는다’는 ❺와 정반대, ‘뇌를 보호’·‘가장 빨리 헤엄침’은 본문과 무관. ① 위험한 장소에서 중앙의 뇌를 손상으로부터 보호하다 ② 모든 메시지를 승인을 위해 뇌로 되돌려 보내다 ③ 문어가 다른 어떤 바다 생물보다 더 빨리 헤엄치도록 돕다 ④ 스스로 지각하고 반응할 수 있는 신경계의 숙련된 가지로서 작동하다 ⑤ 중앙의 뇌가 발달함에 따라 더 길고 강해지다
choice.body: This means that many actions do not require detailed instructions from the brain itself. Instead, the arms function as highly capable extensions of the nervous system that interact with the environment directly. The suckers lining each arm play an important role in this process.
choice.ul: function as highly capable extensions of the nervous system

choice.stem: 다음 요약문의 빈칸 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것을 고르시오.
opt: (A) fortunate — (B) universal — (C) imperfect
(A) humble — (B) universal — (C) imperfect
(A) humble — (B) narrow — (C) timeless
(A) fortunate — (B) universal — (C) timeless
(A) fortunate — (B) narrow — (C) imperfect
choice.ex: (A) fortunate (B) universal (C) imperfect 근거 ❷❺❻❼❽ 해설: (A) ❷❼ 높은 특권을 누린 고대 그리스 엘리트 = 운 좋은 소수(the fortunate few) / (B) ❻ not nearly as inclusive as we would want = 훨씬 덜 보편적 / (C) ❽ for all it does well, … flawed = 장점에도 불구하고 불완전. humble(비천한)은 ❷❼의 특권층과 반대, narrow(편협한)를 넣으면 ‘훨 씬 덜 편협하다’가 되어 ❻과 반대, timeless(시대를 초월한)는 ❺(모든 사상가는 자기 시대에 속함)·despite its strengths와 맞지 않음. 요약문 해석: 아리스토텔레스는 일관적인 사상가였지만, 그의 윤리학은 고대 그리스 사회의 (A) 운 좋은 소수의 가치관을 반영한다. 모든 사상가는 특정한 시대에 속하기 때문에, 좋은 삶에 대한 그의 견해는 오늘날 우리가 기대하는 것보다 훨씬 덜 (B) 보편적이고, 이 때문에 그것은 장점에도 불구하고 (C) 불 완전하다.
choice.psg: ❶ Consistent though he may be, some of Aristotle’s ideas meet us today as strange. ❷ He had no difficulty justifying slavery, for example, and in his era, philosophers enjoyed positions of high privilege and influence. ❸ Because of their practice of contemplation for the highest human good, philosophers were considered worthy to have all the best things in life. ❹ Somehow that assertion seems oddly self-serving. ❺ It serves us to remember that every great thinker is of her own time and speaks to a particular audience, and certainly Aristotle is no exception. ❻ Human flourishing as he understood it probably would not be nearly as inclusive as we would want it to be today. ❼ How he understood right and good is best taken to be an indicator of how the privileged elite of ancient Greek society tended to understand right and good. ❽ As a result, for all it does well, it is also deeply flawed.
choice.body: Although Aristotle was a consistent thinker, his ethics reflects the values of the (A)________ few in ancient Greek society. Because every thinker belongs to a particular time, his view of a good life is far less (B)________ than we would expect today, which makes it (C)________ despite its strengths.

choice.stem: 다음 요약문의 빈칸 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것을 고르시오.
opt: (A) indifferent — (B) convenient — (C) benefited
(A) entitled — (B) convenient — (C) benefited

para.en: Life is full of possibilities. If we, like gardeners, provide a suitable environment and let children grow at their own pace, they will spontaneously explore the world, developing curiosity, creativity, and independence. Such children love life, dare to challenge, and possess initiative. But if we, like carpenters, always try to “shape” children into our ideal image, they will gradually lose autonomy, becoming accustomed to following others’ instructions. Such children quickly lose their sense of direction as they grow, because they are used to being arranged for, rather than actively choosing their path. As parents, our role should be that of gardeners, providing sunlight, rain, and fertile soil, allowing children to grow naturally at their own pace. It should not be that of carpenters, trying to carve out a “perfect” piece according to our will. The core of education starts with understanding life and helping children find their own “map” to find their direction in a complex world.

To see how borrowing and lending changes a person’s worldview, consider what the rate of interest does to people’s perception of time. Imagine you are lending to somebody at an interest rate of 10 percent per year for five years. This rate tells us that the money lent has a cost that reflects the risk of you not being repaid and the opportunity cost of not spending that money yourself. The longer the term of the loan, the higher the chance you won’t be paid back because it is further into the future — which by definition is unknowable — and the longer you will have to wait before spending the money yourself. In order to make this worthwhile for the lender, money has to have a price — a cost to the borrower and income to the lender. This price factors in the value of time. To put it another way, a bird in the hand is worth two in the bush.

Social and environmental responsibility has become an increasingly important ethical consideration for content creators. As global awareness of social, environmental, and sustainability issues grows, many content creators are being called upon to consider the broader impact of their work. This includes addressing topics such as climate change, social justice, and ethical consumerism in their content. Content creators have a platform that can influence their audience’s attitudes and behaviors, and they have a responsibility to use that platform for positive change. For example, promoting environmentally sustainable products or supporting causes related to equality and justice can help raise awareness and drive meaningful social impact. Ethical content creators not only focus on promoting their products or services but also consider the values and causes they support, ensuring that their content aligns with their social and environmental principles.

Research on cephalopod neurobiology suggests that an octopus possesses roughly five hundred million neurons. What makes this system unusual is where many of those neurons are located. More than half are distributed throughout the arms rather than concentrated entirely in the central brain. Each arm contains networks of nerve cells capable of controlling complex movements and responding to sensory input locally. This means that many actions do not require detailed instructions from the brain itself. Instead, the arms function as highly capable extensions of the nervous system that interact with the environment directly. The suckers lining each arm play an important role in this process. These structures provide strong grip but also detect chemical signals on surfaces they contact. Marine biologists studying octopus behavior have shown that this allows the animal to gather chemical information through touch. In practical terms, an octopus can effectively taste what it touches.

Consistent though he may be, some of Aristotle’s ideas meet us today as strange. He had no difficulty justifying slavery, for example, and in his era, philosophers enjoyed positions of high privilege and influence. Because of their practice of contemplation for the highest human good, philosophers were considered worthy to have all the best things in life. Somehow that assertion seems oddly self-serving. It serves us to remember that every great thinker is of her own time and speaks to a particular audience, and certainly Aristotle is no exception. Human flourishing as he understood it probably would not be nearly as inclusive as we would want it to be today. How he understood right and good is best taken to be an indicator of how the privileged elite of ancient Greek society tended to understand right and good. As a result, for all it does well, it is also deeply flawed.
